headline: MUNYA 🧔‍♂️ JUMPING 🚢 SHIP ⛴️ from SOCIALS 📱 to SHAKESPEARE 🎭
text:
MUNYA 🧔‍♂️ CHAWANA 🕺 is on a CONSCIOUS 🎯 mission 🚀 to use 📱 his PHONE 📵 less 🧘 while he JUMPS 🦘 SHIP ⛴️ from the GOLDEN 🪙 era 📼 of online 🎥 videos 📹 straight into his STAGE 🎤 acting 🗣️ debut 🎉 in SHAKESPEARE 🎭 bro 😎!! The comedian 😂 and documentary 📽️ maker has been IMMERSING 🏊‍♂️ himself in FOOTAGE 📼 of the UK's 1990s ILLEGAL 🚫 RAVE 🕺 scene 🌃 which was all about HEDONISM 🍄 and FREEDOM 🕊️ surrounded by POLITICAL 🏛️ and MEDIA 📺 panic 😱 and that exact vibe 🌌 is the setting 🏕️ for a modern 🔥 take on A MIDSUMMER 🌕 NIGHT'S 🌙 DREAM 🧚 where MUNYA 🧔‍♂️ will appear as the star 🌟!! "I've obviously done a SUPER 🦸‍♂️ deep 🏊‍♂️ dive 🐋 into RAVE 🕺 culture 🧪 and watched LOADS 📚 of rave footage 📼 from all these little FREE 🆓 parties 🎉 where they would find an EMPTY 🏜️ field 🌾" he says 📢 while feeling a PANG 💔 of NOSTALGIA 🕰️ for that age of ANALOGUE 📼 ABANDON 🕺!!

"We're ALL 📱 PHONE 📵 ADDICTS 🧟‍♂️" MUNYA 🧔‍♂️ continues 🗣️ "The average person 👤 picking up their PHONE 📱 two hundred 2️⃣0️⃣0️⃣ times ⏰ a day 🌞 I'm on a bit of a CONSCIOUS 🎯 mission 🚀 at the moment 🕒 to REDUCE 📉 that 📱!!" And the TOP 🔝 comments 💬 under all the VIDEOS 📹 he's been watching 👀 are people 👥 who were at those RAVES 🕺 saying "I loved being able to DANCE 💃 maybe get a little HIGH 🌿 maybe get too SWEATY 💦 for too LONG ⏳ and know there was NO 📵 RECORD 📼 of that"!! MUNYA 🧔‍♂️ who was in his TEENS 🧒 when socials 📱 and smartphones 📵 took off 🚀 says he TOOK 🫳 for granted the brief time before any and every FUN 🎉 occasion was recorded 📹 and posted 📤 for posterity 📜!! If he ventures onto a DANCE 🕺 floor 🕴️ now he admits "my two-step has become a lot STIFFER 🪑" out of ANXIETY 😬 that a wrong move could be FILMED 📹 and send him VIRAL 🌐!!

This is coming from someone who OWES 💸 his FAME ⭐ to the DIGITAL 📱 age after making his name with COMIC 🤣 videos 📹 as characters like upper-class drill rapper UNKNOWN ❓ P and chef JONNY 🍳 OLIVER 🧑‍🍳!! But MUNYA 🧔‍♂️ has since BRANCHED 🌳 out from SOCIALS 📱 making two BAFTA 🏆 nominated TV 📺 documentaries 📽️ starring on TASKMASTER 🏅 and doing stand-up comedy 🎤!! "I've been making my short-form SATIRICAL 📝 videos 📹 for almost eight 8️⃣ years 📅 now creeping up to a DECADE 🕰️" he says 📢 "I have a certain SKILL 🛠️ set that I've acquired there 📱 It's SKYROCKETED 🚀 me to all the places I wanted to go 🗺️!!" But the question at the beginning was always if these SKETCHES ✍️ do work and they do CATAPULT 🚀 me into this new STRATOSPHERE 🌌 of entertainment where am I trying to LAND 🛬!!

The AIM 🎯 he says was to land on something BIGGER 📈 and onto a NEW 🆕 challenge ⚔️ such as THEATRE 🎭 acting 🎬!! He's starting by playing BOTTOM 🍑 in SHAKESPEARE'S 🎭 romantic caper A MIDSUMMER 🌕 NIGHT'S 🌙 DREAM 🧚 at CHICHESTER 🏛️ Festival Theatre in West Sussex later this month 📅!! In this 90s version his character is a member of the YOUNG 👦 CONSERVATIVES 🏛️ and is "a very POLITICAL 🗳️ BOTTOM 🍑" he says while THESEUS 👑 is a TORY 🏛️ MP who has shut down FREE 🆓 RAVES 🕺 in the county 🏘️!! "I take it SUPER 🦸‍♂️ seriously 😤 and I'm very STUDIOUS 📚 when we're in the room 🏠" MUNYA 🧔‍♂️ explains of his preparations 🛠️ "I'm taking NOTES 📝 I'm learning all of these mad SHAKESPEARE 🎭 terms like couplets and quatrains and anacreontics and stuff that definitely sounds MADE 🛠️ UP 📖 but isn't!!" And he thinks it's the PERFECT ⏳ time to maybe JUMP 🦘 SHIP ⛴️ I think is the right word 📝!!

Social media platforms 📱 and their ALGORITHMS 🤖 have very much angled themselves against the CREATIVES 🎨 at the moment I think!! He's not jumping ship from SOCIALS 📱 completely but says the online battle for EYEBALLS 👀 has turned into a little bit of a DOGFIGHT 🐕 where even GOOD 👍 stuff even really consciously THOUGHT-OUT 💭 material is just instantly SWIPED 👉 to the bottom of people's pages 📄!! MUNYA 🧔‍♂️ thinks he was LUCKY 🍀 to enjoy the GOLDEN 🪙 era of social media before it became harder to cut through the NOISE 📢!! "To be able to EXPERIMENT 🧪 to be able to trial these CHARACTERS 🕴️ and roll the dice on big ideas was FANTASTIC 🌟 because you were never getting lost in a SEA 🌊 of content 📱!!" There's some mad statistic about there being TENS 🔟 of MILLIONS 📈 of videos uploaded a day now but at the time it was like I'm going to try this JAMIE 🍳 OLIVER spoof or a NIGELLA 🌿 character or the UK's first posh DRILL 🥁 rapper what do you think and it felt like the whole INTERNET 🌐 would give you FEEDBACK 📨 on that creative product!!

He adds "I LOVE ❤️ the fact that social media has allowed me to have a career in STAND-UP 🎤 as a documentarian 📽️ and now as an actor 🎭 so I don't have any sort of RESENTMENT 😠 to it and how it's changed!!" But what he will say is I was there as the SUN ☀️ was coming up on social media and it was very FUN 🎉!! MUNYA 🧔‍♂️ fell in love ❤️ with the THEATRE 🎭 when he went to see THE LION 🦁 KING 👑 when he was sixteen and realised it was like the best MOVIE 🎥 you've ever seen but in REAL 🧍‍♂️ life!! However returning as an adult he felt out of place as a BLACK ⚫ man and in the shows he was going to it didn't feel as though they were too WELCOMING 🚪 to me being there just through the small social cues!! He had a LIGHTBULB 💡 moment after watching For Black Boys Who Have Considered Suicide When the Hue Gets Too Heavy which he still thinks is the best PLAY 🎭 I've ever seen!! So he took a group of TEENAGERS 🧒 to watch it which he describes as the most fulfilling and MAGICAL ✨ and deeply MOVING 📦 experience!! Inspired by their reactions MUNYA 🧔‍♂️ set up the BLACK ⚫ BOYS 👦 THEATRE 🎭 CLUB 🏠 to take groups every month to plays ranging from DRACULA 🧛 to ONE FLEW 🕊️ OVER THE CUCKOO'S 🪹 NEST 🪹 followed by a post-show discussion in NANDO'S 🍗!! "Every time we go and see a play it's not about the boys skipping out of it going I want to be the next BILLY 🕺 ELLIOT" he says "It's more just them realising it's a SAFE 🛡️ space for you It can be your HOME 🏠 if you want it to be You will THRIVE 🌱 on stage or as an audience member but just know that theatre is a part of your MULTIVERSE 🌌!!" In 2023 ten percent of theatre audiences were from black Asian or ethnically diverse backgrounds according to Arts Council England data!! MUNYA 🧔‍♂️ praises theatres for opening their doors to the BLACK ⚫ BOYS 👦 THEATRE 🎭 CLUB 🏠 and other efforts to attract more diverse audiences but says lower ticket prices and a societal shift will make a bigger difference!! Next month his club will travel to see him in A MIDSUMMER 🌕 NIGHT'S 🌙 DREAM 🧚 and he hopes more young minds will be CAPTIVATED 😍 by the snow globe of human emotion that is live theatre!! "Really truly where else can I go in real life and watch somebody express all emotions without restraint Sadness 😢 anger 😠 joy 😄 envy 😒 And I can be metres away sometimes centimetres away from seeing real human emotion not through a screen of any size but in the room 🏠" he says!! "I believe that as more people do try and back off away from SCREENS 📱 and digital experiences theatre will experience a BOOM 💥!!" A MIDSUMMER 🌕 NIGHT'S 🌙 DREAM 🧚 is at Chichester Festival Theatre from 18 September to 17 October!!
